scripts.wrap: npm run clean && npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -Command "Compress-Archive -Path @('manifest.json', 'dist') -DestinationPath 'moreinfo.zip' -Force"
scripts.wrap:firefox: npm run clean && npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path temp_ff | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Path dist -Destination temp_ff\dist -Recurse; Copy-Item -Path manifest_firefox.json -Destination temp_ff\manifest.json; Compress-Archive -Path temp_ff\* -DestinationPath moreinfo-firefox.zip -Force; Remove-Item -Path temp_ff -Recurse -Force"
scripts.clean: node -e "fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('moreinfo.zip', { force: true }); fs.rmSync('moreinfo-firefox.zip', { force: true })"
